# CanEpiRisk

# R Library for Calculation of Lifetime Risks due to Radiation Exposure

Version: 1.0-0 Date: 2025-10-31

Author & Maintainer: Kyoji Furukawa

URL: <https://github.com/KyojiFurukawa/CanEpiRisk>

## Installation

    # install.packages("devtools")
    devtools::install_github("KyojiFurukawa/CanEpiRisk")
    library(CanEpiRisk)

## Vignette

[Getting
started](https://KyojiFurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/articles/CanEpiRisk.html)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`CER()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/CER.md)
  : CER: Calculating Cumulative Excess Risks
- [`CanEpiRisk-package`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/CanEpiRisk.md)
  [`CanEpiRisk`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/CanEpiRisk.md)
  : CanEpiRisk
- [`Comp_Exrisk()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/Comp_Exrisk.md)
  : Calculating excess risks
- [`Incidence`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/Incidence.md)
  : Cancer incidence rates of WHO global regions
- [`LSS_incidence`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/LSS_incidence.md)
  : LSS incidence risk models
- [`LSS_mortality`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/LSS_mortality.md)
  : LSS mortality risk models
- [`Mortality`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/Mortality.md)
  : Cancer mortality rates of WHO global regions
- [`YLL()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/YLL.md)
  : Calculate Years of Life Lost (YLL) due to Radiation Exposure
- [`plot_agedist()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/plot_agedist.md)
  : Plotting age distributions
- [`plot_refdata()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/plot_refdata.md)
  : Plotting reference data
- [`plot_riskmodel()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/plot_riskmodel.md)
  : Plotting risk models
- [`population_LAR()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/population_LAR.md)
  : population_LAR: Population-averaged Lifetime Attributable Risk
- [`population_YLL()`](https://kyojifurukawa.github.io/CanEpiRisk/reference/population_YLL.md)
  : Calculating population-averaged years of life lost
